## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and carry no tool trailers.
- [ ] Branch name matches `(spec|sdk|docs|fix|chore)/<topic>`.
- [ ] **Wire format touched?** A conformance vector lands in this pull request.
- [ ] **Specification touched?** The section and any `[PLANNED]` label match
      what [aria.bar/spec](https://aria.bar/spec) says.
- [ ] No commercial scheme, vendor or laboratory is named in normative text.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry when the change is visible to implementers.
- [ ] **Invariants touched?** Say which and why it does not break credentials
      already issued ([INVARIANTS.md](../INVARIANTS.md)).
